enchantments.tooltip: Quality Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Dexterity.
Smoke Screen: You are surrounded by wisps of concealing smoke, giving opponents a 20% concealment chance to miss you.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Deception +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to hit and +15 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
